zh: 支持不同会话独立同时执行，停止、审批和实时引导按会话隔离；工作目录重叠且涉及写入的任务依次执行。
空闲会话选择执行账号后立即保存，修复选择 Grok 或 Claude 后实际账号仍停留在 Codex 的情况。
缩小侧栏会话名称字号，移除项目与会话旁的铅笔按钮，通过右键改名。
项目右键菜单新增置顶、编辑、分区、永久 Git 工作树、全部已读、归档聊天与移除项目；移除项目保留文件和会话。
移除额外用量提示框，订阅额度和额外用量状态不作为执行门槛。
en: Run independent conversations concurrently with task-scoped stop, approval and live guidance. Tasks with overlapping writable workspaces run in sequence.
Apply account selection immediately to idle conversations so selecting Grok or Claude updates the actual execution account.
Reduce sidebar conversation text size and remove project and conversation pencil buttons; rename through context menus.
Add project context actions for pinning, editing, sections, permanent Git worktrees, read status, archiving and removal. Removing a project preserves files and conversations.
Remove the extra-usage banner; allowance and extra-usage readings do not gate execution.
